# Resources {.unnumbered}

Below you will find resources helpful for SACSCOC reaffirmation preparation.

## Official SACSCOC Publications

::: {.callout-important}
## Primary Reference Documents
These are the authoritative sources for SACSCOC requirements:

- **Principles of Accreditation (2024 Edition)** — The standards against which institutions are evaluated
- **Resource Manual** — Detailed guidance for each standard including evidence suggestions
- **Handbook for Institutions Seeking Reaffirmation** — Process, timeline, and procedural requirements
:::

### Key SACSCOC Documents

| Document | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| Principles of Accreditation | Official standards text |
| Resource Manual | Evidence guidance, questions to consider |
| Handbook for Reaffirmation | Process steps, timeline, responsibilities |
| Substantive Change Policy | Guidelines for reporting changes |
| Faculty Credentials Guidelines | Guidance on faculty qualifications |
| QEP Handbook | Guidance for Quality Enhancement Plan |

## SACSCOC Annual Meeting Sessions

The SACSCOC Annual Meeting offers numerous sessions helpful for reaffirmation preparation. Common topics include:

- Preparing the Compliance Certification
- Developing an Effective QEP
- Faculty Credentials and the Roster Form
- Distance Education Compliance
- Off-Campus Site Requirements
- Financial Standards Compliance

## NC Community College System Resources

::: {.callout-note title="NC-Specific Resources"}
NC community colleges have access to:

- NC Community College System Office guidance
- Peer institutions' experiences and best practices
- Working group collaborations for institutions in the same class
- Shared professional development opportunities
:::

## Self-Assessment Tools

### Compliance Certification Checklist

Before submission, verify:

- [ ] All Core Requirements addressed with strong evidence
- [ ] All Comprehensive Standards addressed
- [ ] Faculty Roster Form complete
- [ ] Institutional Summary Form updated
- [ ] Distance learning addressed in applicable standards
- [ ] Off-campus sites addressed in applicable standards
- [ ] All document links functional
- [ ] CEO signature obtained

### QEP Checklist

- [ ] Topic identified through ongoing planning processes
- [ ] Broad-based support documented
- [ ] Focus on student learning outcomes and/or student success
- [ ] Resources committed (budget, personnel, facilities)
- [ ] Assessment plan with measurable outcomes
- [ ] Implementation timeline included
- [ ] Maximum 75 pages narrative + 25 pages appendices

### On-Site Visit Preparation

- [ ] Hosting committee formed
- [ ] Hotel and workroom reserved
- [ ] Transportation arranged
- [ ] Interview schedule drafted
- [ ] Campus community briefed
- [ ] QEP awareness campaign completed
- [ ] Documents organized and accessible

## Training and Professional Development

### Recommended Training

1. **Orientation Meeting** — Required attendance for Leadership Team
2. **SACSCOC Annual Meeting** — Sessions on reaffirmation topics
3. **QEP Institute** — Guidance for QEP development
4. **Regional workshops** — Various SACSCOC-sponsored events

### Internal Training Suggestions

- Standards overview sessions for all employees
- QEP awareness campaign
- Interview preparation workshops
- Evidence gathering training

## External Resources

### Peer Institution Examples

::: {.callout-tip}
Many institutions publish their Compliance Certifications, QEPs, and accreditation resources online. These can serve as structural examples (though content should not be copied).
:::

### Professional Organizations

- Association for Institutional Research (AIR)
- Association for the Assessment of Learning in Higher Education (AALHE)
- Council for Higher Education Accreditation (CHEA)
